mapper.sql: id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, story_version_id, order_index, title, source_text, source_hash, status, estimated_duration_ms, generation_progress, source_story_version_id, inherited_snapshot_hash
mapper.select: INSERT INTO chapters ( row_version, created_at, updated_at, story_version_id, order_index, title, source_text, source_hash, status, estimated_duration_ms, generation_progress, source_story_version_id, inherited_snapshot_hash ) VALUES ( #{rowVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{storyVersionId}, #{orderIndex}, #{title}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceHash}, #{status}, #{estimatedDurationMs}, #{generationProgress}, #{sourceStoryVersionId}, #{inheritedSnapshotHash} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET story_version_id = #{storyVersionId}, order_index = #{orderIndex}, title = #{title}, source_text = #{sourceText}, source_hash = #{sourceHash}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chapters WHERE story_version_id = #{storyVersionId} ORDER BY order_index ASC, id ASC
